turns.instruction: Analyze the attached continuous beam. Report Uz at the current free end x=12 m and Rz at the x=10 m support. Use the attached input tables and OpenSees, and label each result with location, direction, unit, case/combination and turn.

Change the right overhang length from 2 m to 3 m, so its free end is x=13 m. Keep supports at x=0, 5 and 10 m. The 10 kN downward point force follows the new free end; the downward 8 kN/m UDL covers only the new x=10–13 m overhang. Reanalyze and report current free-end Uz and Rz at x=10 m.
